name: Map a multi-step argument
short_description: Represent at least ten linked claims, objections, and evidence items without losing their logical direction.
self_assessment: I can map ten linked argument elements without help and identify every unsupported conclusion.
description: Represent at least ten linked claims, objections, and evidence items without losing their logical direction. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Map claims and objections in a policy argument
